name: Bakht Bali
contribution: Bakht Bali was a regional rebel leader associated with the local resistance networks that challenged East India Company authority during the 1857 uprising.
context: His activity belongs to the north and central Indian theatre, where local chiefs and military groups joined the wider rebellion through varied alliances and campaigns.
impact: Bakht Bali represents the many regional commanders whose actions made 1857 a connected but uneven series of local uprisings rather than a single centrally directed war.
highlight: Regional commander in the local resistance networks of the 1857 rebellion.
seoTitle: Bakht Bali: Regional Rebel Leader of 1857
seoDescription: Learn about Bakht Bali and the regional resistance networks that challenged East India Company rule during the 1857 uprising.
shortAnswer: Bakht Bali was a regional rebel leader associated with local resistance to East India Company rule during 1857.
